card.name: Last digit inside dose numbers
card.fires_on: Mostly the final digit or unit piece of a number split into parts, such as 50, 125, 100 or mCi, in dosing tables and strengths. Also seen on a few other tokens in section headings.

modes.label: Digit ending a dose number
modes.description: A single digit that completes a multi-digit number in a strength, volume or dose range.

modes.label: Unit piece after a number
modes.description: The end of a unit such as mCi in a radiation dose table.

modes.label: Heading words
modes.description: Occasional words inside numbered section headings in drug labels.

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted tokens look like code-style name pieces and do not fit the text.
card.plain: It fires on the last digit of numbers like 50 or 125 in dose strengths and tables.
